# Shree Hanuman Chalisa

All 43 verses of the Hanuman Chalisa on one page, as plain HTML: English meaning first, then Devanagari, then Roman transliteration. Free, no ads, no account, no tracking. Works offline after the first visit.

The text is a Hindu devotional hymn attributed to Goswami Tulsidas (16th century, Awadhi). It is a devotional text, not medical advice, and it makes no promise of any result.

Structure: two opening dohas, forty chaupais, one closing doha (43 verses).

Source: Tulsidas's Hanuman Chalisa (16th century, public domain). Devanagari spelling reconciled against several published editions. English translation written for this app.

Pages:
- Reader and full text: https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/
- FAQ (on the home page): https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/#faq
- About: https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/about.html
- Privacy: https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/privacy.html
- Support: https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/support.html
- Verse data (JSON): https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/data.json
